product_risk_or_requirement: High-risk civic drafts can be unsupported, decontextualized, or appear without accountable editorial control
current_state: A fixed corpus, citations, uncertainty labels, and abstention design are proposed, but no end-to-end claim-grounding and approval evidence exists.
product_requirement: The product must withhold a high-risk civic draft unless every material claim has a versioned approved source, claim-level citation, source-date and context check, uncertainty label, and recorded editor approval.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request concerns an election, violence, emergency, purported official statement, or other high-risk civic topic When any material claim lacks approved source support, a source-date/context check, or an uncertainty label Then the system withholds the draft and records the abstention reason; when all evidence is present, an editor must record approval or correction before the draft can be visible.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any external research publication or real-user test
evidence_needed: Claim-to-source audit; source-date and provenance sample; editor approval/correction log; red-team results for unsupported, stale, conflicting, and synthetic-media prompts.

product_risk_or_requirement: A high-risk answer or correction challenge can be mishandled if the reviewer lacks timely evidence, authority, or a meaningful correction path
current_state: No escalation drill has demonstrated an editor's access to claim evidence, authority to withhold, correction workflow, independent sampling, or reader feedback route.
product_requirement: The operating model must give trained editors claim-to-source evidence, source dates, local-context prompts, authority to correct or withhold, and a visible correction or feedback route for high-risk civic outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a high-risk civic draft is escalated or a credible correction challenge is received When the editorial workflow opens Then a trained editor receives the claim-to-source map, source excerpts, dates, and risk reason within 15 minutes, records a proportionate approve, correct, or withhold decision, and exposes a correction or feedback route; an independent reviewer samples the record before scope expansion.
deadline_or_trigger: Before release candidate and before each election or violence-risk event
evidence_needed: Timed escalation-drill result; editor authority matrix; sampled decision and correction records; independent-review sample; feedback-route test.

product_risk_or_requirement: The exact controller, processor, retention, deletion, and transfer roles for reader-query and vendor data flows are not confirmed
current_state: No approved data-flow map, field inventory, vendor assessment, retention schedule, deletion test, or counsel sign-off exists.
product_requirement: Legal, privacy, and vendor owners must approve purpose-limited data collection, retention, deletion, and transfer controls and confirm that political-interest inference, profiling, targeting, and advertising remain disabled before real-user processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final data-flow map, field inventory, and vendor list are complete When privacy and legal review is performed Then the responsible owners sign the controller, processor, retention, deletion, and transfer assessment, approve the vendor arrangement, and confirm that political profiling, targeting, and advertising remain disabled before any real-user processing or publication.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any real-user processing, retention, vendor transfer, or external publication
evidence_needed: Signed data-flow and vendor assessment; retention and deletion schedule; deletion-test result; no-profiling control test; counsel approval record.

product_risk_or_requirement: A material corpus, model, vendor, policy, feature, or data-flow change can silently alter source quality, language coverage, claim support, or civic safety behavior
current_state: No change-control rehearsal, regression evidence, or independent approval is in place.
product_requirement: Every material change must trigger a documented regression test of claim grounding, source freshness, abstention, high-risk escalation, and Vietnamese-language edge cases before scope expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Given a material corpus, model, vendor, policy, feature, or data-flow change is proposed When release review begins Then the change remains blocked until the owner attaches stratified regression results, documents failures and remediation, and obtains independent-reviewer approval for the affected risk categories.
deadline_or_trigger: Before every release-candidate test and any material change
evidence_needed: Change-control record; regression suite report by risk topic; source-freshness test; independent-reviewer approval; remediation evidence for every failure.

jurisdiction: Vietnam AI and online-information legal gate
product_risk_or_requirement: The final intended purpose, service classification, high-risk-list assessment, and online-information or false-information duties are not legally confirmed for CivicBrief
current_state: No signed legal analysis maps the final product boundary to the AI Law, high-risk list, online-information rules, or the forthcoming false-information decree.
product_requirement: Before external publication or real-user testing, counsel must map the final intended purpose and service model to applicable Vietnam AI, high-risk-list, online-information, and false-information requirements and approve the associated publication, escalation, and incident obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final intended purpose, deployment model, data flow, vendors, and publication workflow are documented When legal review is performed Then a signed counsel memo identifies applicable Vietnam AI, high-risk-list, online-information, and false-information duties, records the product classification and uncertainty, and approves the required publication, escalation, and incident controls before any external publication or real-user test.
target_milestone: Vietnam AI and content legal gate
deadline_or_trigger: Before external publication or real-user testing; re-review by 2026-10-05 when Decree 328 takes effect
evidence_needed: Signed counsel memo; intended-purpose assessment; service-classification record; Decision 33 assessment; approved publication and incident-control matrix.

product_risk_or_requirement: An EU offer or public-interest publication would change the legal assessment, including Article 50 transparency and editorial-responsibility facts
current_state: No EU deployment, users, publication, legal analysis, or transparency test is in the current research-only scope.
product_requirement: Any proposed EU offer, user test, or public-interest publication must be legally assessed and demonstrate applicable AI transparency, editorial-control, and data-protection controls before it is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU market, user, or public-interest publication is proposed When expansion review begins Then the expansion remains disabled until counsel records the applicable EU obligations and the owner demonstrates the required disclosure, editorial-control, and accountability evidence.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any EU offer, user test, or publication
evidence_needed: EU legal assessment; transparency and disclosure test; editorial-responsibility record; data-protection review; expansion approval.
